title.zh: 修正第929号法案（题为“延长阿尔拜省1903年度土地税缴纳期限至1903年12月1日，并规定退还已缴罚款”的法案），删除该法案标题及第一条中“1903年12月1日”字样，代之以“1904年1月1日”的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-NINE, ENTITLED "AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL DECEMBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID," BY STRIKING OUT THE WORDS "DECEMBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE" IN THE TITLE AND IN SECTION ONE OF SAID ACT AND INSERTING IN LIEU THEREOF THE WORDS "JANUARY FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED NINE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-NINE, ENTITLED "AN ACT EXTENDING THE TIME FOR THE PAYMENT OF THE LAND TAX IN THE PROVINCE OF ALBAY FOR THE YEAR NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE UNTIL DECEMBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE, AND PROVIDING FOR THE REFUND OF PENALTIES ALREADY PAID," BY STRIKING OUT THE WORDS "DECEMBER FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE" IN THE TITLE AND IN SECTION ONE OF SAID ACT AND INSERTING IN LIEU THEREOF THE WORDS "JANUARY FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND FOUR.
title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật Số 929 về gia hạn thời hạn nộp thuế đất tại Tỉnh Albay cho năm 1903 đến ngày 1 tháng 12 năm 1903 và hoàn lại tiền phạt đã nộp bằng cách thay cụm từ 'ngày 1 tháng 12 năm 1903' trong tiêu đề và Điều Một bằng cụm từ 'ngày 1 tháng 1 năm 1904'
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่ 929 ว่าด้วยการขยายระยะเวลาการชำระภาษีที่ดินในจังหวัดอัลบัยสำหรับปี พ.ศ. 2446 จนถึงวันที่ 1 ธันวาคม พ.ศ. 2446 และกำหนดให้คืนค่าปรับที่ได้ชำระไปแล้ว โดยตัดคำว่า '1 ธันวาคม พ.ศ. 2446' ออกจากรายชื่อและข้อ 1 ของพระราชบัญญัตินั้น และแทนที่ด้วยคำว่า '1 มกราคม พ.ศ. 2447'
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Perubahan Undang-Undang Nomor 929 mengenai Perpanjangan Waktu Pembayaran Pajak Tanah di Provinsi Albay untuk Tahun 1903 hingga 1 Desember 1903 dan Pengembalian Denda yang Telah Dibayar dengan Menghapuskan Frasa '1 Desember 1903' dalam Judul dan Pasal Satu Undang-Undang tersebut serta Menggantinya dengan Frasa '1 Januari 1904'
title.ms: Akta bagi Pindaan Akta Nombor 929 berkenaan Perpanjangan Tempoh Bayaran Cukai Tanah di Wilayah Albay bagi Tahun 1903 sehingga 1 Disember 1903 dan Menetapkan Bayaran Balik Denda yang Telah Dibayar dengan Mengeluarkan frasa '1 Disember 1903' daripada Tajuk dan Seksyen Satu Akta tersebut dan Menggantikannya dengan frasa '1 Januari 1904'

text.en:
Act Numbered Nine hundred and twenty-nine, entitled An Act extending the time for the payment
of the land tax in the Province of Albay for the year nineteen hundred and three until December first,
nineteen hundred and three, and providing for the refund of penalties already paid,” is hereby amended by
sinking out he words "December first, nineteen hundred and three, where they occur m the title and in
section one of said Act and inserting in lieu thereof the words “January first, nineteen hundred and four.”

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission in
the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 27, 1903.
